projects.name: Tiny Epic Narrator
projects.about: A private web app for a group of four playing the board game Tiny Epic Dungeons: it reads the Echoes of Aughmoore campaign aloud in Spanish and shows each scene's setup and cards.

rules.language: es: narration and every forum post in Spanish
rules.copyright: no official Tiny Epic Dungeons text, art or stats (README copyright section)
rules.pr_flow: feature branch, push over SSH, gh pr create, link in the thread; never push main, never merge
rules.daily: the maintainer asked (2026-10-31): when a liaison PR has waited 2+ days unmerged, keep one daily branch with every open PR: `pr-daily-branch <clone> --test 'npm test' --apply` (liaison/diaria-<date>), open or keep its PR 'Rama diaria <date>', link it in the thread

projects.name: Spidey PR Dashboard (Watchtower PR)
projects.about: Watchtower PR: a one-page HTML dashboard of a team's Bitbucket pull requests and build pipelines, with alerts and a review queue.

rules.language: es: every forum post in Spanish
rules.pr_flow: work only on branch oscar-review (the maintainers' review branch for the owner): fetch, commit there, push over SSH, link it in the thread; a PR only into oscar-review; never push main, never merge

projects.name: Mosaico (ImgCrypt)
projects.about: ImgCrypt (first called Mosaico): a planned Windows desktop app to find, sort and move large photo and video collections between PC, USB drive and phone, all local and private. Plan stage, no code yet.

rules.language: es: every forum post in Spanish; technical terms in English (RyuuKatze 2026-11-07)
rules.pr_flow: feature branch, push over SSH, gh pr create, link in the thread; never push main, never merge
rules.repo_rules: read the repo's AGENTS.md first: no stack approved yet, privacy (no personal images to any AI, synthetic fixtures only), do not rewrite the maintainers' docs (README, AGENTS, CLAUDE, docs/plan.md, .gitignore)
